Colombia shares a border to the northwest with Panama , to the east with Venezuela and Brazil and to the south with Ecuador and Peru .	Panama	Panama	Venezuela	Venezuela	Brazil	Brazil	Ecuador	Ecuador	Peru	Peru

Colombia is one of the most ethnically and linguistically diverse countries in the world , and thereby possesses a rich cultural heritage .	linguistically	Languages of Colombia	cultural heritage	cultural heritage
